# pcd_compute_servergroup (Resource)

Manages a server group (affinity/anti-affinity policy) in PCD's Nova service. Server groups are immutable; any change forces a new resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the server group.
- `policies` (List of String) Scheduler policies (e.g. affinity, anti-affinity, soft-affinity, soft-anti-affinity).

### Optional

- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The server group ID.
- `members` (List of String) Instance IDs that are members of this server group.
